lexer=re.compile(r'(?P<comment>//[^\n]*|/\*.*?\*/)|(?P<string>(?:u8|u|U|L)?"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*")|(?P<char>(?:u|U|L)?\'(?:\\.|[^\'\\])*\')|(?P<space>\s+)|(?P<token>[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*|(?:\d|\.\d)(?:[EePp][+-]|[A-Za-z_0-9.])*|>>=|<<=|\.\.\.|->|\+\+|--|<<|>>|<=|>=|==|!=|&&|\|\||\*=|/=|%=|\+=|-=|&=|\^=|\|=|##|.)',re.S)
def tokens(src):
    out=[]
    for m in lexer.finditer(src):
        kind=m.lastgroup; token=m.group()
        if kind in ('comment','space'): continue
        if kind=='string' and token.startswith('"'):
            token=token[1:-1]
            if out and out[-1][0]=='string': out[-1]=('string',out[-1][1]+token); continue
        out.append((kind,token))
    return out
report=[]
